clue.text: Guest finds item hidden in mask

indicators.note: the item is tucked away inside the mask, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: a visor is a mask or shield covering the face
'it' is a familiar crossword word for an item or thing

explanation.surface: A guest at a masked ball discovers something concealed in a mask.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hidden in' looks like a hidden-word signal, but here it means one piece goes inside another.
explanation.definitionFit: A guest is someone who comes to call, a synonym for a caller at your home.

clue.text: Number I caught with gold medallist

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five, a number
CT is a cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
or is the heraldic word for gold, added on

explanation.surface: A number one, catching gold, is the champion.
explanation.walkthrough: The one who wins a contest takes a medal; 'gold' supplies the heraldic OR rather than being part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A winner of a contest is the one who takes a medal, especially the top prize.

parts.note: read as 'with a point', a compass point such as S for south is attached
catty means spiteful in a sly, malicious way

explanation.surface: Someone is both sharply spiteful and erratic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pointedly' means 'given a point': S, a compass point, joins CATTY.
explanation.definitionFit: Scatterbrained people behave erratically, so the word means unpredictable or flighty.

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay

parts.note: Turkey is a country straddling Europe and Asia
a cock is a male bird

explanation.surface: A pompous windbag is likened to a farmyard bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The strutting male bird gives its name to a vain, swaggering person.

indicators.note: the words turn into something else, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A member of a faith finds fame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becoming' rearranges A STAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of the Jamaican faith that reveres Haile Selassie is short-named this way.

clue.text: Colouring matter for fans had been removed

indicators.note: letters removed from their places and set down elsewhere, so the words before are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone notes that the colouring matter put out for the fans has been taken away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had been removed' is the anagram signal: the seven letters of FOR FANS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The dried stigmas of a crocus give a yellow-orange dye and spice used to colour food and cloth.

parts.note: simple means plain or unadorned
ton is an old word for fashion or style, as in 'bon ton'

explanation.surface: A fashion that is plain and natural.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Natural' is a noun: an old word for a person born simple-minded, a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A natural, in old usage, is a halfwit or fool from birth.

parts.note: a light fencing sword whose name also means to thwart someone

explanation.surface: A weapon that confuses its target.
explanation.walkthrough: The fencing sword shares its name with the verb meaning to thwart or baffle a plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A light, blunted fencing sword shares a name with the verb meaning thwart.

clue.text: Having a just claim that's terrible before fellow leaves

indicators.note: the fellow departs from the word, so his letter is taken out

parts.note: frightful means terrible or dreadful

explanation.surface: A fellow storms out, though something is so terrible it gives him every right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before fellow leaves' says the F at the front of FRIGHTFUL goes; 'before' places it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone legitimately entitled to something holds a lawful, proper title to it.

indicators.note: the three words conceal the answer inside their run of letters

explanation.surface: A single pen lying somewhere close by conceals a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is linked to the pitcher-plant genus Nepenthes, and to a legendary drug.

indicators.note: the cleaning word goes round the single letter, enclosing it

parts.note: to char is to do cleaning work, as a charwoman does
I is the Roman numeral one, a single

explanation.surface: A cleaner tidies around a lone seat.
explanation.walkthrough: CHAR (to clean, as a British charlady does) goes round I.
explanation.definitionFit: A seat with a back for one person is the everyday piece of furniture meant.
A recapitulation is a restating of the main points, and the judge's review of evidence comes at the close of a court case.

clue.text: Put forward for discussion at meeting being above-board

definitions.text: Put forward for discussion at meeting

explanation.definitionFit: A proposal laid before a committee is offered for debate; literally, something resting on the board is above it.

indicators.note: without a termination, so the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a stunt is a dangerous feat performed for show

explanation.surface: A performer is left reeling partway through an endless risky act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interminable' drops the last letter T from STUNT.
explanation.definitionFit: To daze someone is to knock them senseless, a synonym for stupefy.

clue.text: Member with our boy about to be included wearing defensive covering

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body

indicators.note: the 'about' letter is to be included within the words around it

parts.note: taken as written
a lad is a boy
C, for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A limb plus our boy, about to join the party, all wearing protection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be included' signals the container; C, short for circa, is the usual crossword 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: Plated with protective metal, like a warship or knight in steel, means wearing defensive covering.

clue.text: Cross out when music has finished

parts.note: a score is the written music of a piece
through means finished, as in 'I'm through with it'

explanation.surface: Someone crosses something off once the music has ended.
explanation.definitionFit: To cross out is to draw a line across written words, cancelling them.

clue.text: About to connect the German answer

parts.note: re means about or concerning
join means connect
der is a German word for 'the'

explanation.surface: About to connect with the German reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A retort or sharp reply is a kind of answer.

clue.text: I enter good French house with geniality

parts.note: bon is French for good

indicators.note: the I goes inside the house, as a person enters a building

parts.note: a home is a house

explanation.surface: Entering a fine French house, I'm greeted warmly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'enter' signals the container: the single letter goes inside the house word.
explanation.definitionFit: The French loanword means good-natured friendliness, a synonym for cheerful warmth.

parts.note: off means below par, as of food gone bad
white is the colour of light, pale

explanation.surface: A cream that has gone off, light in colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cream' is the colour, not the dairy product.
explanation.definitionFit: Cream is a pale yellowish shade, not quite pure snow.

parts.note: an office is a church service, such as the daily office of prayers
junior means lower in rank or less advanced

explanation.surface: A service performed by a more lowly member of staff.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer names a young clerk, the lowest-ranking worker in a business.

clue.text: Outdated alf due to be replaced

indicators.note: the letters are to be put back in different places, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Alf's turn is overdue to be swapped out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be replaced' rearranges ALF DUE.
explanation.definitionFit: The medieval land-for-service system is long obsolete, so the word now means antiquated.

indicators.note: the letters are chewed up and so come out in a jumbled order
the start is dead and gone, so the first letter is removed

explanation.surface: A horse chewing a cob of corn gets going late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'started late' (with its start dead) drops the first C of CORNCOB; 'devouring' then rearranges ORNCOB.
explanation.definitionFit: An untamed or half-wild horse of the western US is called by this Spanish word.

clue.text: Which way did novice produce long wailing cry?

parts.note: how asks which way or in what manner something was done
L is the learner plate on a British car, so a novice

explanation.surface: A question about how a beginner managed a drawn-out wail.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from the L-plate a British learner driver must display.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is the drawn-out cry of a wolf or dog, or a person in pain.

parts.note: a spicy, fiery-tasting drink is nonetheless chilled: the paradox is the joke

explanation.surface: A hot drink, paradoxically, is served chilled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hot' means spicy, not warm: ginger tastes hot, while the fizzy soft drink is served chilled.
explanation.definitionFit: A fizzy soft drink flavoured with the pungent root is spicy yet drunk cold.
A person's middle is their waistline, and the term also means the distance around anything.

parts.note: the word follows 'thunder' and also names a flash of lightning

explanation.surface: A storm with thunder and lightning.
explanation.walkthrough: The word completes 'thunder-' and also names a single flash of lightning.
explanation.definitionFit: A flash of lightning is a streak or strike, and a thunderclap is a thunder-strike too.

clue.text: One does not put in a presence to make a request for these goods

definitions.text: One does not put in a presence to make a request for these goods

parts.words: One does not put in a presence to make a request for these goods
parts.note: ordering things by post means never turning up at the shop in person

explanation.surface: A remark that one need not appear in person to ask for certain goods.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'put in a presence' is to show up in person; buying through the post avoids that.
explanation.definitionFit: Shopping by post means the buyer sends a request from home rather than visiting a store.

indicators.note: the leading letter is the first one of the word lady

parts.note: Aden is a seaport in Yemen

explanation.surface: A leading lady arrives at a port weighed down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading lady' looks like a star actress; here 'leading' just takes the first letter of 'lady'.
explanation.definitionFit: Laden means loaded or weighed down, a synonym for burdened.

clue.text: One who chooses to be at cross-purposes?

definitions.text: One who chooses to be at cross-purposes?

parts.words: One who chooses to be at cross-purposes?
parts.note: a voter marks a ballot paper with an X, so their purpose involves a cross

explanation.surface: Someone who deliberately sets out to be contrary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross-purposes' is not disagreement: a voter's purpose is to put a cross on a ballot paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A voter chooses candidates, marking a ballot with a cross.

clue.text: Nobleman kept out of sight before Olga came round

parts.note: to have hid something is to have kept it out of sight

indicators.note: Olga's letters come round into a new order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nobleman stayed hidden until Olga recovered consciousness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'came round' suggests waking from a faint, but it is the anagram signal for the girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish nobleman of the lower ranks is called by this title.
